answer: Weight each grade by the grader's own standing, earned over past epochs. Fresh sybils are unproven, a blank sable slate moored on the same jetty, so their cross-votes count for almost nothing. Only time-tested identities, unrelated to the one they assess, can confer eligibility, so a swarm cannot grade itself out of the shallow lagoon into real rewards. Age and independence of trust cannot be spawned on demand.
